quotes.text: My husband and I wanted a small non- traditional wedding. So we started looking for options. We found Marina Bay boat rentals and it was worth our effort. Everyone was amazing and friendly. The cost was perfect we got married on the water and it felt like we were in another world. Thank you Marina Bay!
